theme_and_style.mode: Light and Dark (Toggle via localStorage, Tailwind 'class' strategy)
theme_and_style.philosophy: COMPACT UI. Density is paramount. Minimize whitespace while preserving readability. Use tight grid structures. Feels engineered, like an aviation dashboard or high-end code editor.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import Geist font via CDN (e.g., from Vercel's Geist font CDN or Google Fonts if available, otherwise setup basic @font-face pointing to standard Geist CDN). Apply text sizes strictly following the compact scale.

colors.tailwind_config_injection: Define CSS variables in a <style> block and map them in the inline Tailwind config object (tailwind.config = { ... }). Use semantic names: bg-background, bg-surface, border-border, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground.

topbar.background: Solid surface color (NO transparent). Must use bg-surface with a subtle border-b border-border.

sidebar_nav_item.classes: flex items-center gap-2.5 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-muted/10 text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground

topbar_elements.search_input: h-7 text-xs rounded-md bg-background border-border pl-7 pr-3 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary w-48 sm:w-64
topbar_elements.icon_button: h-7 w-7 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md hover:bg-muted/10 transition-colors text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground

empty_state_placeholder.layout: flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-[calc(100vh-9rem)] w-full rounded-lg border border-dashed border-border/80 bg-surface/50
empty_state_placeholder.visuals: Use an inline Heroicon (e.g., Dashboard or Folder icon) styled with text-muted-foreground/30 at w-6 h-6, followed by text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mt-2. Keep it ultra-minimalist.

icons.sizing: Compact UI demands small icons. Default to w-3.5 h-3.5 or w-4 h-4 max.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all buttons and nav links (transition-colors duration-200). Sidebar collapse needs smooth layout interpolation.
motion.theme_switch: Swap classes instantly on the root `<html>` element. Avoid heavy background transitions on theme swap to prevent performance jank.

instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_cdn: Insert `<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>` in the `<head>`. Immediately follow with a `<script>` setting `tailwind.config = { darkMode: 'class', theme: { extend: { colors: { background: 'var(--background)', surface: 'var(--surface)', border: 'var(--border)', foreground: 'var(--foreground)', 'muted': 'var(--muted)', 'muted-foreground': 'var(--muted-foreground)' }, fontFamily: { sans: ['Geist', 'sans-serif'] } } } }`. Add a `<style>` block for CSS variables mapped to the Light/Dark palettes defined above.
instructions_to_main_agent.laravel_blade_context: Write this as a single comprehensive HTML layout (simulating a Laravel Blade layout or view). You can use plain HTML + Tailwind, and simple Vanilla JS at the bottom of the document to handle the state (Theme toggle logic storing to localStorage, Sidebar collapse logic). NO React, NO Vue, NO Alpine.
instructions_to_main_agent.compact_enforcement: Strictly enforce small dimensions. Do NOT default to p-6 or p-8. Use p-2, p-3, p-4. Headings shouldn't exceed text-base.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility_and_testing: Include `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (theme-toggle, sidebar-toggle, nav-dashboard, user-menu, search-input).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this by making the compact UI feel deliberate, high-end, and technical.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds over content. Headers must be solid.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, active states).
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use Heroicons inline SVGs for all icons and avatars.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="theme-toggle-btn"`).
